blocks.title: Lobby / Public Space
blocks.body:
Typical consideration: Arrival, seating, and brand-appropriate public space.
Owner planning consideration: Confirm layout, FF&E, and conversion flexibility.
Typical status: Typically Expected
Notes to confirm: Upscale/collection may require higher design investment.

blocks.title: Guestroom Standards
blocks.body:
Typical consideration: Bedding, bath, work area, finishes, and FF&E per prototype.
Owner planning consideration: Confirm PIP scope, procurement, and room mix.
Typical status: Typically Expected
Notes to confirm: Conversions often need project-specific review.

blocks.title: Fitness / Pool
blocks.body:
Typical consideration: Fitness and/or pool where prototype requires.
Owner planning consideration: Confirm minimum size, equipment, and operating cost.
Typical status: May Apply
Notes to confirm: Economy brands may have reduced requirements.

blocks.title: Signage / Exterior
blocks.body:
Typical consideration: Brand signage and exterior identity.
Owner planning consideration: Confirm monument, façade, and permitting.
Typical status: Typically Expected
Notes to confirm: Radisson-family flags have distinct identity packages.

blocks.title: Technology / Systems
blocks.body:
Typical consideration: PMS, CRS, loyalty, Wi-Fi, and reporting integrations.
Owner planning consideration: Confirm cutover timeline, training, and recurring tech fees.
Typical status: Typically Expected
Notes to confirm: Mandatory Choice stack beyond headline royalty.

blocks.title: Training / QA
blocks.body:
Typical consideration: Opening checklist, Choice University training, and QA inspections.
Owner planning consideration: Confirm inspection fees, remediation, and ongoing QA cadence.
Typical status: Typically Expected
Notes to confirm: Upscale QA burden exceeds economy.

blocks.title: Site & Feasibility
blocks.body: Confirm Econo Lodge product fit, competitive set, and whether Choice Privileges can move the market before LOI.

blocks.title: Application & Approval
blocks.body: Submit through Choice Hotels International development; expect brand standards review and fee exhibit confirmation—no invented percentages.

blocks.title: Design & PIP
blocks.body: Budget design latitude vs prototype; conversion PIP must fund the guest-facing promise, not a cosmetic flag swap.

blocks.title: Pre-Opening
blocks.body: Systems cutover for Choice Privileges, training, and brand QA before soft opening.

blocks.title: Stabilize
blocks.body: Watch loyalty mix, channel contribution, and QA scores through the first 12–24 months.

blocks.title: Renewal / Exit
blocks.body: Model renewal PIP, transfer, and termination mechanics from the live agreement—not peer rumor.

Guests: Affordable economy lodging for value-conscious travelers.

Owners: economy Choice flag with portfolio distribution and standards clarity.

Underwrite contribution after fees, loyalty costs, and channel mix versus comp set.

Owners exiting failed midscale who need economy positioning.

Markets that cannot support economy ADR or required amenity stack.
Heavy conversion PIP misaligned with building constraints.
OTA-heavy mix without modeling net after retail and member discounts.
Operator tier mismatch shows in QA and reviews first.
Sponsor KPIs should track contribution and direct mix—not vanity metrics.
